Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.flowassurance

Class SilicaScaleSaturation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.flowassurance.SilicaScaleSaturation
public final class SilicaScaleSaturation extends Object
Activity-based saturation for the dissolution of pure silica polymorphs, SiO2(s) + 2 H2O = H4SiO4(aq).

The activity inputs come from a separately qualified aqueous speciation model. Total dissolved silicon is not the activity of neutral orthosilicic acid. The calculation does not model precipitation quantity, rate or deposition.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

  • Method Details

    • saturationIndex

      public static double saturationIndex(double log10SilicicAcidActivity, double log10WaterActivity, double log10DissolutionConstant)
      Evaluates the saturation index at the supplied activity and mineral equilibrium conditions.
      Parameters:
      log10SilicicAcidActivity - decimal logarithm of molality-standard-state H4SiO4 activity, or negative infinity when dissolved silica is absent
      log10WaterActivity - decimal logarithm of positive solvent water activity
      log10DissolutionConstant - decimal logarithm of the mineral-specific dissolution constant at the same temperature and pressure as the activities
      Returns:
      decimal-log saturation index, or negative infinity when silica is absent
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an activity logarithm or the equilibrium constant is invalid

    • log10DissolutionConstantAtOneAtmosphere

      public static double log10DissolutionConstantAtOneAtmosphere(SilicaScaleSaturation.Mineral mineral, double temperatureK)
      Evaluates the silica dissolution constant at 1 atm using the PHREEQC 3.7.3 Pitzer database.

      This screening reference is restricted to 25 to 100 degrees Celsius. Use a qualified external equilibrium constant for elevated-pressure work. The database analytical expression takes precedence over the tabulated reference constant for amorphous silica.

      Parameters:
      mineral - silica polymorph
      temperatureK - temperature, K
      Returns:
      decimal logarithm of the dissolution constant at 1 atm
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if temperature is outside 298.15 to 373.15 K
      NullPointerException - if the mineral is absent
